title: Padres call up 20-year-old catcher Ethan Salas
dek: The San Diego Padres promoted catcher Ethan Salas, age 20 and the team's top prospect, to the major leagues on Tuesday. The franchise has viewed Salas as its catcher of the future since signing him.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Ethan Salas, 20, was called up to the Padres' major-league roster on Tuesday.
bottom_line: Salas's performance and playing time during the stretch run will indicate whether the Padres see him as part of their immediate offensive solution or are signaling long-term succession planning.
body: The San Diego Padres called up catcher Ethan Salas, age 20 and the franchise's No. 1 prospect, to the major leagues on Tuesday, according to MLB.com. The Padres have viewed Salas as their catcher of the future from the moment they signed him.
